RLMD: Strong Ph2 NMIBC data (94% anytime CR, 86% 18-mo durability) but the US IND is still pending, with CGON about 2 years ahead on a BLA. Cash of $202M is 52% of the $385M cap; execution and Ph3 funding are the test.
ORIC: Rinzimetostat plus darolutamide held 59% landmark rPFS at 8-10 months post-abiraterone, no Gr4/5 AEs. An $815M cap on Ph1b data with Ph3 enrolling; $345M cash funds into 2H 2028.
RLAY: Zovegalisib's 11.1-month mPFS (n=57) and Breakthrough status are cross-trial, and a $3.8B cap against $849M cash leaves little room. Ph3 ReDiscover-2 faces approved capivasertib; the Dec 14 ASH data are in vascular anomalies, not breast.
TELO: Preclinical metal chelator w zero human data: $36M cap rests on only $6M of cash, so dilution comes well before any clinical proof.
MGNX: MGC026 cleared SCCHN Stage 1 with no ILD or ocular toxicity seen (n=74 enrolled), but Daiichi/Merck's ifinatamab deruxtecan is about 2 years ahead. Cash of $288M exceeds the $139M cap.
PMVP: Rezatapopt posted a 46% ORR (35/76) in TP53 Y220C ovarian cancer with no approved rival; the $90M cap sits below $109M of cash. Runway is only about 6 quarters, and NDA filing is planned Q1 2027.
PYXS: MICVO monotherapy gave 36% cORR, 94% DCR and 6.2-mo mPFS (n=33), but Corbus's CRB-701 shows similar ORR with a clearer regulatory path. Cash is thin at $57M; 1L pembro data in Dec and FDA feedback in Q1 2027.
AVBP: FURVENT missed its PFS endpoint (HR 0.75, p=0.0654) despite 60% vs 33% ORR, and Dizal/AstraZeneca's sunvozertinib leads in 1L ex20ins. $393M cash backs a $602M cap; ALPACCA and a Q1 2027 update remain.
FHTX: Lilly ended FHD-909 in Oct 2026, leaving a preclinical EP300 degrader with IND targeted 2027 and no human data. Cash of $156M covers the $130M cap, but 7.4 quarters of runway erodes that floor.
EIKN: EIK1001 + pembro + chemo showed 63.1% ORR (n=65) vs roughly 40-47% for standard of care, but single-arm. The $292M cap is under $462M cash; the randomized Ph2/3 interim in 2H27 is the real test.
IMTX: Anzu-cel shows 56% cORR and 14.6-month mDOR, and the market pays roughly $430M above its $536M cash. Lifileucel is approved and about 1.5 years ahead; SUPRAME PFS topline is 1H 2027.
HURA: Preliminary Merkel cell data are due 1H 2027, but there is no efficacy data yet, Ph3 enrollment has slipped to 2H 2027, and cash is $2M against $9M debt (about 0.3 quarters of runway). A raise looks near-certain before either.
ERAS: ERAS-0015 shows 57% uORR (n=7) in PDAC and 62% (n=37) in NSCLC, early and unconfirmed, with Ph3s starting 2027. A $5.3B cap against $948M cash assumes it beats Revolution Medicines, which already has randomized Ph3 data; we see it as richly valued.
FENC: PEDMARK Q3 sales rose 56% to $19.4M with $5.8M adj EBITDA, and cash is $49M. A $484M cap needs the niche, formulary-driven ramp to keep compounding.
LXEO: At 1.3x cash ($293M cap vs $234M), the market pays little for LX2006's +115% frataxin data. The 13-vs-13 pivotal reads out in 2H27, BLA is 2028, and LRMR's nomlabofusp BLA is ~18 months ahead.
MLYS: Two positive pivotals and a Dec 22 PDUFA, with a $1.3B cap about 2x its $625M cash. As the #2 entrant behind AstraZeneca's approved baxdrostat in a price-pressured HTN market, payer terms will set the ramp.
GOSS: The market already prices the trial miss, and with the stock at roughly its cash the question is purely whether the FDA accepts a single-trial package. Very high risk of a CRL and of further dilution.
CNXU: Preclinical, with unreviewed animal data and $7M of cash (3.8 quarters) against a $59M cap. A 510(k) filing is not expected until early 2027, and filler makers are already commercial; funding comes before revenue.
INCY: Povorcitinib HS has a positive CHMP and a Q1 2027 US launch, but a $25B cap already sits on ~$5.3B of guided 2026 net sales, so HS looks incremental rather than a re-rating.
OCUL: AXPAXLI SOL-1 met its superiority-design primary (p=0.0006) and the NDA is slated for Q4 2026, not yet filed. The stock is down ~49% over 12 months; EYPT's DURAVYU is close behind and SOL-R in 2028 tests durability.
OCS: After OCS-01 failed Ph3 in DME, privosegtor has BTD and ACUITY data (+18 letters LCVA). Cash of $282M is 60% of the $471M cap and no NAION drug is approved, though the data are Ph2.
TARS: XDEMVY sold $194.6M in Q3 (+64% y/y; $513.9M YTD, >$1B cumulative) with no direct Demodex competitor. A $3.9B cap is ~5x annualized Q3 sales and rests on one product; Ph2 pipeline reads 1H 2027.
NRXS: Revenue is doubling (Q2 $1.9M, +116%) on a new CPT code at a $75M cap, but $8M cash and 4 quarters of runway make dilution real risk.
PHVS: The on-demand NDA has an Apr 23 2027 PDUFA and prophylaxis cut attacks 83% (n=85). But a $2.3B cap with $321M cash is rich while KalVista's Ekterly is already approved as the first oral.
JSPR: Dual-action complement drug for PNH (controlling both types of red-cell destruction); $7.3M cash against a $13M cap makes it a distressed micro-cap, though low price flatters long.
SYRE: SKYLINE Part A was positive across three antibodies but open-label, and the edge is mainly convenience. A $9.4B cap vs $1.1B cash leaves the Q3 2027 randomized Part B topline to prove it; stock up 268% in a year.
SANA: The 14-month UP421 result is one patient with donor islets, not SC451. Vertex is far ahead, and $122M cash runs only to mid-2027, so financing looks likely before 2027 data. $577M cap.
TVTX: FILSPARI grew 120% to $200.2M in Q3 with 1,932 new starts, and FSGS is now approved. A $4.8B cap already reflects that against Tarpeyo, Fabhalta and newcomers; HARMONY Ph3 reads 2H 2027.
ELOX: Readthrough agent with only n=3 Alport biopsy responses, so the evidence is thin. The $146M cap is about 2.6x its $56M cash, and the EXACT Ph2b 16-week topline in mid-2027 is the real test.
DNTH: A $5.1B cap rests on Ph2 gMG data alone; EMERGE Ph3 reads 2H 2028 and MMN Ph2 topline is Dec 2026. $1.2B cash covers years, but argenx, UCB and Alexion are entrenched in gMG.
TLSA: Foralumab hit its PET microglial primary at 50 ug only in a 48-patient Ph2a, with EDSS unchanged. With $1M cash against an $85M cap, financing matters more than the FDA meeting; stock is down 64% in 12 months.
MIRM: FY26 sales guidance of $715-720M against a $6.0B cap is about 8.4x, and $731M of debt sits against $501M cash. FDA wants a new PSC Ph3, so the Q4 brelovitug HDV topline carries near-term weight.
PRME: PM577a, a one-time Wilson's approach, dosed its first patient Oct 5 with data in 2027. A $760M cap on first-in-human prime editing; the $143.7M Nov raise funds it through 2027, so it is a wait for data.
ACRS: After bosakitug missed in AD on Nov 16, ATI-052 carries the company (Ph1b AD EASI -45% placebo-adjusted, asthma FeNO -59%). The $565M cap is 2.8x cash; the EoE Ph2b starts Q1 2027, so data are far off.
AVTX: LOTUS (n=253) hit at both doses (HiSCR75 42.2%/42.9% vs 25.6% placebo), yet the stock is down 35% in a month and trades below its $463M cash. FDA Ph3 feedback is due by YE26; bimekizumab's ~49-50% is the bar.
ZBIO: INDIGO cut IgG4-RD flare risk 56% (HR 0.44, p=0.0005) and the BLA is accepted (PDUFA May 27, 2027). But a $1.9B cap vs $647M cash and $399M debt leans on a modest market and an unproven SLE Ph2 in Q4.
KYTX: SPS BLA completed Nov 12 with priority review sought; KYSA-8 (n=26) showed 49% T25FW gain and 92% off chronic therapy. No approved SPS drug, but cash of $171M is 4.4 quarters against a $301M cap.
PYPD: Priority-review NDA has a PDUFA date of Nov 28 and Azurity is preparing an early 2027 launch. With only $16M cash (~2.7 quarters) against a $130M cap, financing likely follows the decision.
AVIR: C-BEYOND matched Epclusa on SVR24 (93.9% vs 94.8%), with 8 weeks sufficing in non-cirrhotic patients. HCV is a genericized, entrenched market, though $191M cash is 58% of the $331M cap.
IVVD: LIBERTY was positive (n=210) and the DECLARATION interim is imminent, but it reports titers, PK and safety, not efficacy. $126M cash is 79% of the $160M cap, with about 3 quarters of runway.
NNVC: Zero human efficacy data, $3M cash (~1.6 quarters) against a $33M cap, and an Ebola/mpox pivot that adds headlines rather than evidence; dilution is base case.
GYRE: China Ph3 showed Ishak fibrosis regression and the NDA is in NMPA priority review, with no approved China CHB fibrosis rival. $99M cash and $33M quarterly revenue support it; the US MASH path is years off.
VCRE: The +23 mL FVC gain in IPF (n=48) came against an external control, so it is not yet proof. ASPIRE Ph2b reads mid-2027, and $77M cash covers only about 5.5 quarters on a $286M cap.
RNTX: Inhaled IPF peptide w promising biomarker data but no controlled efficacy yet; $44M cash roughly matches $35M micro-cap, still unproven.
RDY: Generic semaglutide (non-inferior on HbA1c, n=312) is approved in 10 countries, supply resuming Nov 2026, plus an abatacept biosimilar PDUFA on Dec 22. Biocon, Cipla, Sun are racing it; semaglutide is one driver of a $12B cap.
PTCT: Q3 revenue of $357.8M (Sephience $181.9M, +20% q/q) and FY26 guidance of $1.29-1.32B give a real base. Even so, $2.8B of debt and a $5.1B cap are a lot to carry, and Novartis controls votoplam in HD.
ZVRA: Only approved NPC drug, MIPLYFFA booked $34.0M in Q3, but total revenue slipped from $39.7M to $37.8M. $271M cash is about half the $550M cap; infant sNDA is due Q1 2027.
XERS: Recorlev grew 93% to $71.5M and Q3 revenue rose 44% to $107.2M, with FY26 guided to $395-405M. A $3.1B cap is about 7.6x that, and XP-8121 Ph3 topline is late 2028. Cash $131M, debt $190M.
MDGL: Rezdiffra sales hit $431.3M in Q3 (+50% YoY) with a first profitable quarter. The $9.8B cap already prices a strong ramp, so F4c cirrhosis data (late 2027) and GLP-1 MASH entrants decide the next leg.
VKTX: VK2735 showed 14.7% (SC) and 12.2% (oral) weight loss at 13 weeks, backed by $960M cash. At a $3.4B cap, 2027 VANQUISH completion must hold up against Lilly and Novo, years ahead commercially.
GUTS: Pivotal 6-month win (n=308, p=0.0023, no device SAEs), with De Novo filing late Q4 2026. With $47M cash against $61M of debt and runway to about Q2 2027, a raise likely comes around 12-month data.
DYN: Priority-review BLA with a Jan 21, 2027 PDUFA; dystrophin rose from 0.83% to 5.46% versus ~1% for Sarepta's exon-skippers. A $3.1B cap is cushioned by $1.1B cash, so the rest hinges on the other programs.
CPIX: After selling its brands to Apotex for $100M, the stock trades near cash ($78M cap vs $81M). Ifetroban showed ~5.4% LVEF benefit in 41 DMD patients, but no Ph3 design or funding is announced; Capricor is a rival.
XENE: X-TOLE2 showed a -42.7% placebo-adjusted seizure reduction (p<0.0001) and the NDA went in Sep 17; FDA acceptance is still pending. Enterprise value is about $2.8B, with $1.2B cash and cenobamate entrenched.
CAMP: A $350M cap, 2.8x its $125M cash, for a program with only seizure-model data. Trials are cleared in Australia, Argentina, UK and EU, first dosing is guided by YE2026, and a human miss would leave little margin.
NGEN: NVG-291 showed GRASSP +3.7 vs +0.4 placebo (n~24, p=0.0155) in chronic SCI and has Breakthrough designation. $57M cash is 29% of the $196M cap and guided to last 12 quarters, past the 1H 2028 RESTORE topline.
VYGR: Cash of $132M is 1.3x the $101M cap heading into VY7523 tau-PET data (Q4 2026). Anti-tau efficacy is unproven, and UCB and J&J are well funded rivals.
MNOV: COMBAT-ALS topline (n=234) is due by end of 2026, a binary readout for a $66M cap with $29M cash. Ibudilast has the least differentiated mechanism against approved AMX0035 and tofersen.
ACIU: VacSYn Ph2 (n=34) met safety and immunogenicity endpoints with antibodies in CSF, but efficacy is unproven. Cash is 65% of the $141M cap, runway ends around Q4 2027, and a CEO search is under way.
LXRX: INPEFA, a dual SGLT1/2, faces genericizing SGLT2 rivals, so the $779M cap (4.3x $183M cash) leans on SONATA-HCM Ph3 topline and the Zynquista NDA resubmission, both Q1 2027, plus Novo's LX9851 obesity deal.
SCLX: Distressed: $3M cash against a $12M cap, a stockholders' deficit and SEMDEXA NDA slipped to 2027; 77% drop does not make it cheap, since dilution or insolvency is base case.
NMRA: Navacaprant failed Ph3, so NMRA-511 is the reset bet: a Ph1b showed a 15.7-point CMAI drop in Alzheimer's agitation. With $86M cash, $55M debt and 2.8 quarters of runway, financing comes before a Ph2 start.
ANRO: Evidence is thin: ALTO-207 has only a 32-patient Ph2a, and ALTO-101 missed in another indication. A $1.3B cap with $319M cash leans on PACE-2 Ph3 starting early 2027 and PACE-1 topline in 2H 2027.
VNDA: Q3 net product sales were $69.8M against a $230M cap and $141M cash. Quimilza's PDUFA on Dec 12 and BYSANTI's launch into a market of entrenched generics are the swing factors.
BRVE: A fourth-in-class myosin inhibitor: Ph3 is enrolling and Hengrui China Ph3 topline (1H27) is the first efficacy test, with mavacamten, aficamten and EDG-7500 ahead. $504M cash buys time, but $1.8B is a rich cap for this stage.
SCTX: STX-1150 cut LDL-C >50% in NHPs for nearly 18 months, but there is no human data and Verve/Lilly are ahead in the clinic. A $291M cap with $174M cash; Ph1 SAD data (1H27) is the first human test.
SER: Once-daily SC apomorphine faces AbbVie's Vyalev, w Ph1 SAD data only in 1H27; $25M cash is 71% of $35M cap, but convenience-only differentiation and dilution risk say pass.
KRSA: No human data yet; Ph1 healthy-volunteer results are due mid-2027. A $1.8B cap already assumes the shuttle works and can compete with Roche's Ph3 trontinemab; $456M cash funds into 2029.
CTY: Biomarker-only Ph1 (85% FXI knockdown, no bleeding or VTE endpoints) in a field led by Bayer, BMS/J&J and Anthos/Novartis. The $968M cap is 6.8x its $142M cash, with 4.7 quarters of runway. ASH data Dec 12.
RTSN: Ph2b SBP data in 1H27 follows an n=40 pilot with p-values but no mmHg effect disclosed. A thin-float $89M cap, lock-up expiry around Apr 2027 and likely further financing weigh against baxdrostat and lorundrostat.
